entities.name: Anđa Jelavić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anđa Jelavić is a former Croatian female basketball player and current basketball coach. At the 2012 Summer Olympics, she competed for the Croatian national team in the women's event. She is 5 ft 8 inches tall.
